import sys

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def mod_pow(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * base % mod
        base = base * base % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    P, K = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())
    used = [False] * P
    components = 0
    for i in range(1, P):
        if not used[i]:
            components += 1
            curr = i
            while not used[curr]:
                used[curr] = True
                curr = curr * K % P
    exponent = components
    if K == 1:
        exponent += 1
    ans = mod_pow(P, exponent, MOD)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
